# WebCraft

> WebCraft builds $500 small-business websites and provides hosting, local SEO, Google Ads and analytics. Based near Cleveland, Tennessee; remote-first; serving businesses across an approximate 200-mile service area in Tennessee, Georgia and North Carolina. There are no physical offices in the cities served.

## Services

- Web design: $500 one time for up to five pages, with a custom design, mobile layouts, a contact form and full file ownership. Extra pages are $50 each.
- Web hosting and care: $20 a month, optional.
- Local SEO: quoted around your market.
- Google Ads: quoted around your market.
- Analytics: quoted around your market.
